Hey {{first_name}}! ⚡ Here is the complete breakdown of our **Autonomous Video Production Architecture**:

📐 **The 4-Layer Autonomous Stack:**
1. **Ingestion:** YouTube Data API (viral outlier detection) + Perplexity (fact-check)
2. **Synthesis:** Fable 5.1 (script) + ElevenLabs V4 (broadcast audio) + Suno (soundtrack)
3. **Motion Engine:** HyperFrames CLI (code-rendered HTML/GSAP scenes) + Pixabay/Pexels fallback
4. **Packaging:** FFmpeg (hardware 60fps mux) + GPT Image 2.5 (thumbnails) + Zernio API (auto-publishing)

Tap below to download our full architecture PDF and inspect the open-source repository list 👇
